title: Change databricks delta table typr to external
question:
I have a MANAGED table in delta format in databrciks and I wanted to change it to EXTERNAL to make sure dropping the table would not affect the data. However the following code did not change the table TYPE and just added a new table property. How can I correctly convert my managed table to an external table ?

%sql
alter table db_delta.table1 SET TBLPROPERTIES('EXTERNAL'='TRUE')

Describe Table:

# Detailed Table Information

Name
db_delta.table1

Location
dbfs:/user/hive/warehouse/db_delta.db/table1

Provider
delta

Type
MANAGED

Table Properties
[EXTERNAL=TRUE,overwriteSchema=true]
answer:
It doesn't seem that SET TBLPROPERTIES('EXTERNAL'='TRUE') actually changes the table to external. To fix it you first need to unset the EXTERNAL property:

ALTER TABLE db_delta.table1 UNSET TBLPROPERTIES ('EXTERNAL');

Now you can change the table to external using a scala notebook:

import org.apache.spark.sql.catalyst.catalog.{CatalogTable, CatalogTableType}
import org.apache.spark.sql.catalyst.TableIdentifier

val tableName = "table1"
val tableDb = "db_delta"
val tableMeta: CatalogTable = spark.sessionState.catalog.getTableMetadata(TableIdentifier(tableName, Some(tableDb)))
val alteredTable: CatalogTable = tableMeta.copy(tableType = CatalogTableType.EXTERNAL)
spark.sessionState.catalog.alterTable(alteredTable)
